Asha (CSM): Quick weekly check-in for Orbiton private/VPC. Region rollup: us-east: good, eu-west: intermittent KMS timeouts Fri->Sat. Sharing metrics below.

Liam (Eng): Can you paste numbers for uptime, latency, error rate?

Asha (CSM): Usage: +12% wk/wk, avg tokens/s 1.8k, spend ~flat. Last 7d:
- eu-west uptime 99.2% (target 99.95)
- eu-west 95th latency 420ms (target 250ms)
- KMS errors: 5 timeouts, 1 HSM failover

Riley (Infra): I dug in — we saw peering flaps between customer VPC and our egress in eu-west-1 during maintenance window. KMS requests retried too aggressively; backoff insufficient.

Asha (CSM): Specific log sample from the customer's router:
```
2026-03-14T03:13:02Z ERROR orbiton-kms-proxy: request failed 504 KMS timeout
2026-03-14T03:14:45Z WARN orbiton-gw: short TCP reset from provider
```

Riley (Infra): Proposed immediate mitigations:
1) increase KMS client retries + exponential backoff
2) extend connection timeout for eu-west to 60s
3) route heavy batches to secondary region (eu-central) during peak
Config snippet we'll roll:
```
connectionTimeout=60000  # ms
maxRetries=8
retryBackoff=exp
```

Liam (Eng): +1 to that plan. Also propose a controlled canary replay at 30% traffic to validate before full cutover. Who owns canary window?

deploy-bot: orbiton-eu-west-1-gw rolling restart completed (initiated 1767760000). No errors reported.

Asha (CSM): Onboarding note: Orbiton's PM (Orion) is ramping users next month. Renewal window Q3 — if perf remains unstable risk moves to medium. I'll flag for priority.

Orion (Customer): Thanks for the details. ETA on fixes? We need stable latencies before ramp.

Riley (Infra): Canary started for KMS retry patch in eu-west now. I'll watch alerts and post results here. If green, full rollout EOD tomorrow. /alerts subscribe orbiton-cs

Liam (Eng): I'll schedule the replay load for Tue 09:00 UTC, 30% of current peak. Will post playbook.

Asha (CSM): Great — I'll tell Orbiton and update renewal risk tracker. Weekly pulse here please. :thumbsup:

Riley (Infra): Monitoring dashboard link: https://internal.redwood/ops/dashboards/orbiton-eu-west

Asha (CSM): Thanks team — closing this week's check-in.
